name: cross-session-thread
why: Notes are rewritten whole from one session's transcript, so folding chat B can drop an open thread only chat A knew about. Memory belongs to the bartender, not the chat.

messages: I'm moving my blog to the new server this week.
Good plan. How far along are you?
Files are copied. I still have to switch the DNS over, and I keep forgetting.
Noted: the DNS switch is still to do.
Can you find me a lasagne recipe for Saturday? Eight people.
A classic beef lasagne scales well to eight.
Great, I'll need to buy the pasta sheets on Friday.
